verdict.rationale: Tilled provides payout visibility, batch settlement, webhooks for real-time events, and a 'reporting console' mentioned for enterprise partners, which are building blocks for reconciliation, but there is no documented settlement/balance report API, scheduled file delivery, or per-seller vs rolled-up reporting output for finance systems to consume. missing for 10: explicit reconciliation/settlement report API or downloadable file exports, scheduled delivery mechanism, and per-seller vs aggregate rollup reporting.
